name: QuantumX
shortDescription: Leading the research about Quantum Machine Learning and Financial Quantum Applications
description: During the research at QuantumX we developed Quantum Algorithms based on classic machine learning algorithms targeting estimation of the risk of debt insolvency through CVaR and Altman's Z-Score.

name: Mastercard TIP
shortDescription: Setting up the whole cloud environment of the TIP project from Mastercard on Google Cloud.
description:
Setup and management of the Development and Production infrastructure for Mastercard's Tourist interactive platform.
The project involved the setup of an highly-available cluster of servers with Cloud SQL read replicas for the REST services.

name: Azimut/Chatbot
shortDescription: Intranet integration with Google's Dialogflow CX. A work developed along with Google as partner.
description: Development of an autonomous agent capable of supporting Azimut's Agents on the company intranet, allowing to search across documents. Currently under research with Google to move functionalities upon google's Vertex AI.

name: AXA
shortDescription: Development of AXA public site with Liferay and Maintenance operations through RedHat's OpenShift.
description:
Development of AXA's public site with Liferay and Maintenance operations through RedHat's OpenShift.
Configured infrastructure pipeline for Continuous Integration, Continuous Testing and Continuous Development with Jenkins.
Developed with SMC.

name: Capitanerie
shortDescription: Leading the back-end development of the italian Port Authorities public portal, developed with Liferay, Java EE and React.js
description: Development of Liferay Portal customization for the Italian Port Authorities, developed with Java 11 EE and Elasticsearch for the Back-end and React.js bundled with rollup and injected with JSPWriter for the front-end.

name: Regione Sicilia
shortDescription: IT Consultancy, back-end development and fixes with Java 7. DevOps work to migrate the portal to PSN.
description: Maintenance of the regional portal of Sicily related to the land registry.

name: Senato
shortDescription: Back-end development of the portal of the senate of the italian republic, developed with Liferay and Java EE
description: Maintenance, development and bugfix of the Twitter integration for the Senate of the italian republic, developed with SMC.

name: PSN
shortDescription: Leading the back-end development of the italian IT Authority portal, developed with Liferay and Java EE
description: Coordinating the development of the Liferay Portal for the Italian IT Authority, the website will be used to handle the government organizations intranet and services developed with Java 11 EE for the back-end.

name: Regione Veneto
shortDescription: Full stack development of the regional portal with Liferay, Java EE and FreeMarker Templating
description: Development of Liferay customization for the Venetian Regional Portal, developed with Java 8 EE and Elasticsearch for the Back-end and FreeMarker Template with JSPs for the front-end.

name: Lambda
shortDescription: The pythonic replacement for GNU AWK, embrace Lambda functions on the CLI
description: Development of a functional tool to embed python inside my own shell at home. The idea is to provide the full extensibility of Python while allowing a syntax that's easy to operate from the shell.

name: Mediolanum
shortDescription: Migrating Java EE compliant legacy code after 12 years, from Java 6 to 11.
description:
Migration of codebase from Java 6 to 11, optimization of SOAP and RESTful services with asynchronous queues. Various BugFixes and installation of QA infrastructure based on SonarQube with custom plugin developed for Liferay.
Developed with SMC.

name: BKN301
shortDescription: Safe transactions across the world, setting up the custom blockchain of BKN301
description: Installation of the infrastructure on Google Cloud for the fork of the Stellar Blockchain used from BKN301. Development of a custom liveness checker for the Stellar blockchain forked by BKN301.

name: Spiagge.it
shortDescription: REST service to retrieve data from BigQuery and CyberSec approach against SQLInjection
description: Development of an optimal query to search data across materialized views and programmatically update materialized views, REST service built upon Quarkus with Vert.x to manage request asynchronously. Custom SQLInjection checker with in-memory H2 Database and custom JDBC Driver.

name: Azimut/FAST
shortDescription: Installation of the AllFounds' Fast Blockchain for Azimut. Case study of connecting two Cloud vendors environments.
description: Installation of the AllFounds Blockchain Bank custom ethereum ledger, installed with Google Kubernetes Engine. Installation of CloudSQL PostgreSQL Database and Hashicorp Vault necessary for the participant nodes to properly work.

name: Azimut/Reports
shortDescription: Tools for generating financial reports and elaborate billions of rows per second.
description:
Development of Web Tool to generate reports from billions of rows, reports contains the whole history of Azimut Life saving plans. Tool is used on a daily basis internally by Azimut (Ireland and Italy).
The development involved also the migration of data from an external provider, importing a whooping 1PB of rows of historical data and elaborating financial indexes across all data.

name: Azimut/NAV Engine
shortDescription: REST service for financial consultants to keep track of up-to-date NAV values, developed with Quarkus and Liferay.
description: Development of Web Tool to navigate, compute and track NAV (Net Asset Value) from Azimut's Assets, development involved the search for a robust Ellyptic Curve for custom cryptography needed for the intranet communications (client request).
